Our customers love how closely the Snowy Alpine replicates the freshly cut, snowy trees from Christmas films. Combining a flocked and frosted mix of traditional PVC and expertly moulded PE branch tips, you get a realistic Christmas tree that doesn't scrimp on essential snowy features. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 8ft • Number of Branch Tips: 1133 flocked PE/PVC branch tips • Tree Width: 120cm diameter • Foliage colour: Heavily snow flocked dark green • Realistic look: A mix of ultra-realistic plastic moulded tips, with traditional PVC tips to fill out any gaps • Easy assembly: Attached Hinged Branches • Sturdy base: Folding metal stand with plastic tips to prevent scratching • Indoor use only: Tree and snow flock must be kept dry • Height measured from the floor • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. w5d5pefs.baseName: Walplus Christmas Cone Tree 64 cm Wide - Black - 120 cm
w5d5pefs.variantName: Walplus Christmas Cone Tree 64 cm Wide - Black - 120 cm
w5d5pefs.sourceDescription: This Christmas Cone Tree is a stunning addition to any space, embodying the clean lines and minimalist aesthetic synonymous with modern style. Crafted for festive cheer, it offers a sleek alternative to traditional holiday décor, capturing the eye with its streamlined form and elegant matte black finish. Perfect for both home living rooms and commercial halls, its understated beauty invites a sophisticated holiday ambiance into any indoor or sheltered outdoor setting. Materials: Featuring a combination of sleek steel and solid pine wood, this tree marries strength and aesthetic appeal. The abrasion-resistant steel ensures longevity, allowing the tree to maintain its form year after year, while the solid pine wood lends a natural touch to the base. Included Components: The assembly includes a supportive Christmas tree stand made from robust solid pine wood. Its brown hue adds warmth, complementing the tree's overall design. Designed to provide unwavering stability, it ensures that your artificial tree stands tall regardless of holiday hustle and bustle. Features /Function /Design: Characterized by its matte finish, this Christmas Cone Tree's non-reflective surface provides a subtle elegance, allowing it to blend seamlessly with contemporary décor. It's perfect for those who appreciate subtlety in their holiday decorations, making it appealing in both residential and commercial settings. Recommended Uses: Ideal for indoor spaces such as living rooms and hallways, this tree offers versatility for any festive occasion. It suits both home celebrations and professional holiday displays, radiating charm and sophistication wherever it's placed. Care &Maintenance: Ensuring longevity and appearance is simple with assembly guided by provided instructions. While requiring a screwdriver, the process offers straightforward setup, ensuring your Christmas Cone Tree stands proudly for numerous holiday seasons to come. Product Specifications Colour: Black Material: Steel Tree height: 126 cm Bottom diameter: 64 cm Stand size: 40 x 64 cm Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
